scope: World Human head/body/detached hands only; independent from prop B and portrait illustration styles.
prompt_policy: Preserve the accepted production prompt verbatim. Do not silently introduce texture, prop-style instructions, new models, skills or editing workflow. Character identity changes require explicit production brief; they do not authorize changing the rendering/part contract.
reference_policy: Only original user-provided references/samples; all generated outputs including accepted outputs prohibited as visual generation inputs, edit targets and positive/negative references.
rendering: Minimalist pawn, circular head, simple dome body, smooth consistent near-black outline, flat opaque fills, dot eyes, crisp antialiasing; no painterly/grain/plastic rendering.

layout.rule: Inspect actual dimensions per output, not assumed prompt size. No implicit resampling.

hands.decision: User accepts current hand size for now. Keep it unchanged until user evaluates actual game tests; do not shrink automatically.
hands.prompt_numeric_intent: Original accepted prompt contains 42x48 hand size intent; this was not achieved literally. Preserve prompt provenance; do not use that intended number to reject or rescale the accepted output.
hands.anatomy: Separate stylized palms allowed by latest user instruction; no attached arms, fingers, legs or feet.

limits: Exact NudeBase vector geometry reuse not achieved by this image generation method.
Eye-closed head is not certified identical outside eye region.
Exact SpriteRects, pivots, assembly, directional transition and game-scale appearance remain to validate.
User acceptance of source atlas is not Unity integration or gameplay test completion.
